A human says

Mac mini M4 · task reasoning

Reasoner

What should be done?

  • Reads the instruction + scene image
  • Uses visually grounded scene evidence
  • Selects and orders manipulation skills
  • Proposes a semantic task plan
OUT · Semantic task plan
Mac → Linux · Execution handoff

Interpreter

What does execution need?

  • Checks plan and object references
  • Packages scene evidence with task intent
  • Hands off an execution request to Linux
OUT · Typed execution request

Executor · Linux

How do the arms move?

  • Modified GRIT for hand grasp
  • C++ RMPflow motion execution
  • Motion objectives and execution constraints
  • RB-Y1 integration in MuJoCo
OUT · Simulated robot motion
RB-Y1 in MuJoCo · No fluid simulation

Design principle

Meaning stays at the top.
Physics stays at the bottom.

The layers are designed to exchange structured task intent and scene evidence. Their integration is ongoing.
